verdict.rationale: n8n documents a first-party MCP Server Trigger node, and the probe confirms an official MCP server at that docs page, so external agents can connect to n8n workflows exposed as MCP tools. The evidence is only a page title and probe hit, with nothing on setup, transport, auth or which tools are exposed. Missing for 10: detailed docs on connecting an external agent (auth, transport, tool exposure), independent or hands-on corroboration.
